description: Dependency updates of CiNim (docs/deployment.md, "Dependency updates"). Nothing is merged by the bot: a pull request is built and tested by the pipeline like any other, and a person merges it.

customManagers.description: A pin that carries its source in the comment above it: `# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=owner/repo [extractVersion=...]` and the next line `ARG NAME=value` (Dockerfiles) or `NAME=value` (scripts)
The images the pipeline runs its steps in (.ci/pipeline.lua: `local NAME = "image:tag"`)

packageRules.description: Nim is one version everywhere: the images of the platform, the image of the tests and the workstation must agree (CLAUDE.md; 2.2.6 wrote a wrong request line for HTTPS through a proxy). One pull request for all of them, never merged by the bot. Only patches of 2.4 are proposed: a new minor version is moved to by the owner (2.4.0, 2026-11-10).
prBodyNotes: Nim is one version in `tools/image/Dockerfile.deps`, `Dockerfile.test`, the soak image and on the workstation (CLAUDE.md). A new version is checked by the whole pipeline before it is merged.

packageRules.description: The images that carry a digest in the repository keep it up to date
The Caddy node of the store is an image of the project with its own tags (h79): moved by hand with the chart (deploy/charts/cinim-storage)
nghttp2 1.61 or later is required (nimgrpc); the four places that build it are moved together
